title: SRE weekly ops sync + reliability review notes - 2026-03-18 (draft)
content:
Purpose: prep notes for weekly SRE ops sync + reliability review (cover SLO health, paging trends, top incidents, and action items). Quick notes / scratchpad style - will tidy for meeting minutes after sync.

Attendees (planned): Samira (me), Jordan, Marcus, Priya, Alex R., Nikhil
Duration: 45m

Agenda (rough)
- Quick wins & shoutouts (5m)
- SLO snapshot + error budget burn (10m)
- Paging and on-call trends (10m)
- Deep dive: Top 2 incidents this week (15m)
- Action items & follow-ups (5m)

SLO snapshot (as of 2026-03-17 23:59 UTC):
- Hosted API (text/generation) availability SLI: 99.95% monthly target 99.9% -> current month: 99.87% (error budget used: 30% this month, +12% WoW)
- API latency p95 (hosted): target <200ms -> current week p95 = 230ms (regression starting 2026-03-13)
- Embeddings endpoints availability: 99.99% -> current month 99.995% (good)
- Dedicated (reserved capacity) API SLO: 99.9% -> current month 99.92% (within budget)
- KV-cache hit rate (global prefix cache): baseline 62% -> this week 48% during spike (cache invalidation suspected)
Notes: The latency regression correlates with two deploys (CHG-289) that changed cache invalidation logic and rollout of runtime kernels. Need to correlate request traces to releases.

Paging trends (last 7 days):
- Total pages: 42 (vs 28 last week)
- Pages by priority: P0=1, P1=6, P2=35
- Top paging sources: serving-runtime (18 pages), routing-layer (10), infra autoscaler (6), monitoring (8 generic alerts)
- On-call fatigue signals: average ack time increased to 8m from 4m (note: pages spike outside US business hours)
- Pattern: many pages are repeat alerts for "high inference-latency" tied to KV-cache miss storms -> investigate threshold tuning and runbook clarity

Top incidents (priority for review)
1) INC-4521: Dedicated GPU pool OOM -> short outage (2026-03-14 02:12-02:17 UTC)
   - Symptom: multiple dedicated-worker pods OOMKilled, autoscaler slow to replace under high memory churn from model shards. Impact: ~7% of dedicated requests retried/failures for 5 minutes for a subset of customers.
   - Probable root cause: memory fragmentation + new model quantization config in PR#342 that increased working set for certain models under long sequences.
   - Mitigation taken: rolled back PR#342 on 2026-03-14 02:25, scaled dedicated pool manually, temporary increase of memory limit for affected node pool.
   - Next steps: revert change permanently or add canary with memory regression checks; add pre-deploy memory soak tests for quantization profiles.
   - Owner: Marcus (follow-up: submit revert+postmortem)

2) INC-4518: KV-cache invalidation bug -> latency regressions on hosted API (multiple small outages via timeouts)
   - Symptom: prefix cache invalidation triggered across many keys after a deployment, causing heavy backend recompute and p95 spike.
   - Root cause: rollout changed TTL semantics and a race in invalidation propagation between regions (CHG-289).
   - Impact: P95 increased to 230ms, increased pages, some customer retries.
   - Mitigation: temporary throttling of invalidation events, hotfix applied to coordination layer (deployed 2026-03-15 11:00 UTC).
   - Next steps: add integration test for invalidation propagation, extend cache metrics (per-region invalidation rate) and alerting, consider circuit-breaker on invalidation storms.
   - Owner: Jordan (owns follow-up tests + dashboard)

Other noteworthy items
- Autoscaler flapping on spot pools during region-elective maintenance -> created CHG ticket with infra (CHG-295). Need better bump strategy for scheduled maintenance windows.
- Observability: missing structured trace attributes for retry reasons (retry_count, retry_reason) in a handful of services. Add to tracing SDK backlog.
- Cost/Perf: Redwood Optimize suggestion (#opt-suggest) to increase batching window for low-concurrency routes - potential 8-12% token-cost win but may impact latency; product needs to sign off.

Action items (concrete)
- Marcus: Draft postmortem for INC-4521 (root cause, timeline, mitigation, follow-up) - due 2026-03-20. [JIRA-INC-4521]
- Jordan: Add integration test for cache invalidation propagation + dashboard panels for per-region invalidation rate - due 2026-03-24. Track in github.com/redwood/release/pull/350.
- Samira (me): Update runbook for "high inference latency" to include KV-cache storm playbook + Add pager escalation clarity (who to call after 15m unanswered) - due 2026-03-22.
- Priya: Run memory soak tests for quantized models across sequence lengths and report anomalies (coordinate with Marcus) - due 2026-03-23.
- Nikhil/Infra: Adjust autoscaler bump strategy for scheduled maintenance and add a mitigation play in runbook - due 2026-03-26.
- Team: Triage Redwood Optimize batching suggestion with product (mark P1/P2) - owner product-hosted-api (Priya) - due 2026-03-25.

Open questions / discussion points for sync
- Do we want to temporarily tighten cache invalidation thresholds to avoid repeated storms? Pros/cons?
- How aggressive should memory guardrails be for quantized model deploys (fail fast vs conservative rollout)?
- Paging policy: add second-tier escalation for repeat pages from same service within 24h? (reduce noise)

Notes to self / meeting prep bullets
- Bring timeline of CHG-289 -> correlate exactly which merges touched cache TTLs (have PR list: PR#336, PR#340, CHG-289)
- Bring traces for 2026-03-13 21:00-23:00 UTC window (span ids, p95 candidates)
- Confirm rollback timestamp for PR#342 and the exact delta in memory usage from canary runs
- Ask infra for node-level OOMKill logs and if kernel-level oom_score adjustments were set by cluster-autoscaler

Follow-ups after meeting (what I'll update)
- Publish cleaned meeting minutes to Confluence under /reliability/weekly/2026-03-18 (include action items with owners and dates)
- Create consolidated dashboard that surfaces: SLOs, pages/week, top active incidents, per-region cache invalidation rate, KV-cache hit-rate trend.

Quick links (scratch)
- INC-4521: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-4521
- CHG-289: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CHG-289
- PR#342 (quantization mem change): https://github.com/redwood/release/pull/342
- Reliability dashboard (draft): https://confluence.redwood.com/reliability/dashboards

End of notes - will tidy post-sync and publish minutes + assign Jira follow-ups.
